name: sell-covered-call-pons
description: List a covered call on PONS with the token approval handled: lock amount of PONS and offer the right to buy it for strike until expiry (max 24 hours). Returns the option id.

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: Must be the PONS token address.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Tokens in base units (token decimals). PONS is 18 decimals.

inputs.name: strike
inputs.description: Total strike for the whole amount, in wei of ETH (not per token). Must be at least minStrike per token.

inputs.name: premium
inputs.description: Premium the buyer pays, in wei of ETH. Minimum 0.0005 ETH; a 3% fee is taken from it when filled.

inputs.name: expiry
inputs.description: Unix timestamp when the option expires; 1 hour to 90 days from now (24 hours max for Pons launchpad tokens).

inputs.name: offerDeadline
inputs.description: Unix timestamp until which the offer can be bought; at most expiry.
